Card Q&A.a: No, if you only have one or the other, you can place it in digivolution cards.
Card Q&A.q: If I don't have both [Starmons] and [Pickmons] in my trash, does that mean I can't place any digivolution cards under the played [ShootingStarmon] for this card's [On Deletion] effect?

Effect: [On Deletion] You may play 1 [ShootingStarmon] from under your Tamers without paying the cost. Then, place 1 [Starmons] and 1 [Pickmons] from your trash as that Digimon's bottom digivolution cards.
Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If this Digimon has the [Xros Heart] trait, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -2000 DP for the turn.
